proof_body:
by
  intro H _ _ _ B c hc h f
  have hB : IsCoercive B := ⟨c, hc, h⟩
  let A := hB.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin
  have hA : ∀ v w, B v w = inner ℝ (A v) w := fun v w => (hB.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin_apply v w).symm
  refine ⟨A.symm ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm f), fun w => ?_, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  · rw [hA, A.apply_symm_apply, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
  · apply A.injective
    rw [A.apply_symm_apply]
    apply (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).injective
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    ext w
    rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, ← hA, hv]
target_source: ∀ (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ u, c * ‖u‖ * ‖u‖ ≤ B u u) → ∀ f : StrongDual ℝ H, ∃! v : H, ∀ w, B v w = f w
